title: TLS protocol policy re-enabled every protocol in apache — review required
description: SSLProtocol all re-enables protocol versions the platform disabled, including SSLv3 and TLS 1.0 where the library still implements them. Clients can then negotiate a version with known weaknesses. The rule flags the directive; whether the listener is reachable is a review question.
remediation: Set SSLProtocol to -all followed by TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3 only.
limitation: Lexical: matches one SSLProtocol line; a later line that disables protocols again is not linked.
